The '''Permondiri system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Permondiri Explorer/Legends|''Permondiri Explorer'']].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|20|''Permondiri Explorer''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Permondiri [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-13.<ref name="TEA" />
